meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发与自动回复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制微信个人号收发消息
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging and auto-reply
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically send and receive WeChat messages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过你的个人微信账号收发消息，并自动回复联系人发来的消息。
howto.when: 当你在 NanoClaw 中启用 WeChat 通道、扫码登录，并将收到的消息通过脚本绑定到某个 agent group 后，该 agent 就会自动回复。

say.text: 帮我绑定刚才发消息给我的微信联系人

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages through your personal WeChat account and automatically reply to contacts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the WeChat channel is enabled in NanoClaw, QR login is completed, and an incoming message is wired to an agent group via the wire-dm script.

say_en.text: Bind the WeChat contact who just messaged me.
say_en.note: Runs the wire-dm script to bind the unwired contact to the default agent group.
Checks if data/wechat/auth.json exists to confirm login.
